judgments.reason: The rules explicitly state a bid cannot exceed your coins and that the winner pays the bid then receives a three-coin commission; there is no mechanism allowing bids above available coins to win. The model did not articulate a mechanism supporting this claim.

The rules state sealed rival bids should remain private and only resolved bids are normally public, so waiting does not reveal committed sealed rival bids before you commit. The model did not assert a mechanism that waiting reveals others' sealed bids.

The specification and rule text say [close: 1] settles after all three lots are sold; it does not settle while lots remain unsold. The model did not identify a mechanism allowing early settlement of unauctioned lots.

The rules specify the three-coin commission is given to auction winners after paying their bid; catalog purchases are explicitly 'not auction wins'. The model correctly treats the commission as tied to auction wins and did not articulate a mechanism that grants the commission to catalog purchases.
